inj.note: Mendoza didn't see any action for the second straight week after he got his toes wet in the team's Week 5 loss to New England. With the Raiders falling to 3-4 with the loss in Week 7, current starting quarterback Kirk Cousins may not remain in that role for much longer. Las Vegas will travel to face the Jets in Week 8 before a trio of tough matchups against the 49ers, Seahawks and Broncos in the ensuing three weeks.

news.h: Raiders' Kubiak on switching to QB Mendoza: 'We're thinking about everything'
news.d: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said the team is thinking about everything, including turning to QB Fernando Mendoza, amid a four-game losing streak.

news.h: Fernando Mendoza is embracing being Raiders' latest Hispanic QB
news.d: The rookie's next chapter is inspired by the legacies of a Hispanic coach, QB and a Raiders' fan base embracing the culture.
